commitResults.messageTitle: ErmActually.java: Add On command to print deadlines/events on a date

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract console interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move command reading and all user-facing output out of ErmActually so the main class can focus on coordinating application behavior. Centralize separators and response formatting in Ui while preserving the existing console text exactly. This creates the first focused collaborator needed for the target OOP design and makes later Parser, Storage, and TaskList extractions easier to isolate.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task persistence into Storage
commitResults.messageBody: Move file access, save-format encoding, legacy decoding, and saved-task reconstruction out of ErmActually into a path-configured Storage collaborator. Keep loading and saving errors expressed as ErmActuallyException so the main class retains control of user-facing responses and fallback behavior. This separates persistence from command coordination without changing the existing file format or console output.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: encapsulate task collection in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of task collection mutations, indexing, counts, and date-based selection. Update ErmActually to coordinate through TaskList, let Ui render the wrapper without performing occurrence checks, and let Storage iterate tasks without receiving the mutable backing list. The defensive constructor and snapshot iterator prevent collaborators from replacing or structurally modifying the internal collection.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract command interpretation into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce Parser to recognize command types, validate command arguments, parse dates and task indexes, and construct todo, deadline, and event tasks. Replace the long conditional command chain in ErmActually with a coordinator switch and shared add/save handling. This completes the minimum Ui, Storage, TaskList, and Parser separation while preserving all existing command behavior and error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Unify GUI and CLI command handling
commitResults.messageBody:
The GUI only echoes user input because command execution and response
formatting are confined to the console loop.

tasks during initialization, return reusable response strings, and surface
startup and command errors in JavaFX dialogs.

to use isolated files so verification does not overwrite user data.
